items.title: Tyler Huntley: Three total TDs in comeback OT win
items.text:
Huntley completed 24 of 32 passes for 201 yards and two touchdowns while rushing six times for 20 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Zay Flowers: Eight catches from Huntley in OT win
items.text:
Flowers (foot) caught eight of nine targets for 53 yards and added a 13-yard rush in Sunday's 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons.

items.title: Drake London: Team-high 118 yards in OT loss
items.text:
London caught seven of 11 targets for 118 yards in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.

items.title: Derrick Henry: Over 100 rushing yards with receiving TD
items.text:
Henry rushed 24 times for 102 yards while catching one of two targets for an 18-yard touchdown in Sunday's 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons. He also ran in a two-point conversion.

items.title: Bijan Robinson: Posts 118 scrimmage yards in OT loss
items.text:
Robinson rushed 17 times for 86 yards while catching four of seven targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 30-23 overtime loss to the Ravens.
